about: The local sample set from PLAN.md step 0.8, written by tools/samples/gather. alert_path and meta_tags give the unit each file is scanned as: an email is the alert's root file email.rfc822 with no tags, and anything else is an email attachment at the alert's top level tagged type=email.attachment. Files under local/ aren't in git; rerun the script to make them.
